name: Grainbook
summary: A personal app for habits, study, training and money, kept like a woodworker's notebook
about: A complete personal system on warm paper with a walnut sidebar, filled with a hundred days of sample data for Bilal, a woodworker in Lahore. It tracks habits as growth rings, runs a focus timer for study, plans training week by week, keeps a budget in rupees and moves furniture commissions across a workshop board. Good for a habit tracker, a personal dashboard or a self-improvement app, in light or dark.
how: Open Today: the growth rings draw in from the centre, one ring per week of habits
Tick a habit and the outer ring grows, the day score gauge fills and the streak counts up
Start the focus timer on Today or Study; when it ends the session is logged to your course
In Training, drag a planned session to another day (or use Move to…) and switch 30D, 60D, 100D on the weight chart
In Money, add, edit or delete transactions in the drawer, change budget limits and drop money into the savings jar
In Workshop, drag commissions from Enquiry to Delivered; delivering one offers to add it as income
Write a journal line with a mood face, export CSV files or reset the demo data in Settings; Ctrl+K searches everything
